title: First-Order Reversible Isomerization
description: Minimal well-mixed reversible unimolecular isomerization reaction (A <-> B) with mass-action kinetic law in a single cytosolic compartment.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="ReversibleIsomerization" name="First-Order Reversible Isomerization">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="reactor" name="Well-Mixed Reactor" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="A" name="Reactant Isomer A" compartment="reactor" initialConcentration="10.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="B" name="Product Isomer B" compartment="reactor" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="kf" name="Forward Rate Constant" value="0.35" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kr" name="Reverse Rate Constant" value="0.12" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_isom" name="Reversible Isomerization" reversible="true">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="A" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="B" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>reactor * (kf * A - kr * B)</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Michaelis-Menten Enzymatic Kinetics
description: Two-step enzymatic catalysis (E + S <-> ES -> E + P) demonstrating enzyme-substrate complex formation, steady-state turnover, and product accumulation.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="MichaelisMentenKinetics" name="Michaelis-Menten Enzymatic Kinetics">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cytosol" name="Cytosol" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="S" name="Substrate" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="12.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="E" name="Free Enzyme" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="1.5" constant="false"/>
      <species id="ES" name="Enzyme-Substrate Complex" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="P" name="Product" compartment="cytosol" initialConcentration="0.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="k_on" name="Association Rate Constant" value="0.6" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_off" name="Dissociation Rate Constant" value="0.15" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_cat" name="Catalytic Turnover Rate" value="0.45" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_bind" name="Substrate Binding" reversible="true">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="S" stoichiometry="1"/>
          <speciesReference species="E" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="ES" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>cytosol * (k_on * S * E - k_off * ES)</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_cat" name="Catalytic Conversion" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="ES" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="P" stoichiometry="1"/>
          <speciesReference species="E" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>cytosol * k_cat * ES</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Lotka-Volterra Ecological Oscillator
description: Nonlinear predator-prey population dynamics encoded as an SBML reaction network with autocatalytic prey growth, predation coupling, and predator mortality.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="LotkaVolterraOscillator" name="Lotka-Volterra Predator-Prey Oscillator">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="ecosystem" name="Ecosystem Habitat" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="Prey" name="Prey Population" compartment="ecosystem" initialConcentration="40.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="Predator" name="Predator Population" compartment="ecosystem" initialConcentration="9.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="alpha" name="Prey Intrinsic Growth Rate" value="0.55" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="beta" name="Predation Encounter Rate" value="0.028" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="delta" name="Predator Reproduction Efficiency" value="0.024" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="gamma" name="Predator Natural Mortality Rate" value="0.80" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_prey_birth" name="Prey Reproduction" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="2"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>alpha * Prey</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_predation" name="Prey Consumption" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="Prey" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <listOfModifiers>
          <modifierSpeciesReference species="Predator"/>
        </listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>beta * Prey * Predator</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_pred_birth" name="Predator Growth" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts>
          <speciesReference species="Predator" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers>
          <modifierSpeciesReference species="Prey"/>
          <modifierSpeciesReference species="Predator"/>
        </listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>delta * Prey * Predator</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_pred_death" name="Predator Mortality" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants>
          <speciesReference species="Predator" stoichiometry="1"/>
        </listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw>
          <formula>gamma * Predator</formula>
        </kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: Repressilator Synthetic Genetic Oscillator
description: Elowitz and Leibler three-gene transcriptional ring oscillator (LacI, TetR, cI) with Hill-function repression, mRNA translation, and first-order degradation.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="Repressilator" name="Elowitz-Leibler Repressilator Genetic Oscillator">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cell" name="E. coli Cell Volume" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="mLacI" name="LacI mRNA" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="5.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="mTetR" name="TetR mRNA" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.2" constant="false"/>
      <species id="mcI" name="Lambda cI mRNA" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.2" constant="false"/>
      <species id="pLacI" name="LacI Repressor Protein" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="20.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="pTetR" name="TetR Repressor Protein" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.5" constant="false"/>
      <species id="pcI" name="Lambda cI Repressor Protein" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.5" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="alpha0" name="Basal Transcription Leak" value="0.03" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="alpha" name="Maximal Regulated Transcription" value="30.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="KM" name="Repressor Half-Maximal Affinity" value="40.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="n_hill" name="Hill Cooperativity" value="2.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k_tl" name="Translation Rate" value="5.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kd_m" name="mRNA Degradation Rate" value="0.35" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kd_p" name="Protein Degradation Rate" value="0.07" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_tx_lacI" name="LacI Transcription" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="mLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="pcI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha0 + alpha / (1 + pow(pcI / KM, n_hill))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tx_tetR" name="TetR Transcription" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="mTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="pLacI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha0 + alpha / (1 + pow(pLacI / KM, n_hill))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tx_cI" name="cI Transcription" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="mcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="pTetR"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>alpha0 + alpha / (1 + pow(pTetR / KM, n_hill))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tl_lacI" name="LacI Translation" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="pLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="mLacI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>k_tl * mLacI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tl_tetR" name="TetR Translation" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="pTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="mTetR"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>k_tl * mTetR</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_tl_cI" name="cI Translation" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="pcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="mcI"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>k_tl * mcI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_mLacI" name="mLacI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="mLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_m * mLacI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_mTetR" name="mTetR Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="mTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_m * mTetR</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_mcI" name="mcI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="mcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_m * mcI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_pLacI" name="pLacI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="pLacI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_p * pLacI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_pTetR" name="pTetR Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="pTetR" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_p * pTetR</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_deg_pcI" name="pcI Decay" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="pcI" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd_p * pcI</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

title: MAPK Signaling Cascade with SED-ML Experiment
description: Three-tier Huang-Ferrell MAPK phosphorylation cascade (MKKK -> MKK -> MAPK) with negative feedback inhibition paired with a SED-ML simulation protocol.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="MAPKCascade" name="Three-Tier MAPK Phosphorylation Cascade">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cytoplasm" name="Cytoplasm" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="MKKK" name="Inactive MAPKKK" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="90.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MKKK_P" name="Active MAPKKK-P" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="10.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MKK" name="Inactive MAPKK" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="280.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MKK_PP" name="Active MAPKK-PP" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="20.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MAPK" name="Inactive MAPK" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="280.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="MAPK_PP" name="Active MAPK-PP" compartment="cytoplasm" initialConcentration="20.0" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="V1" value="2.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="Ki" value="9.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K1" value="10.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="V2" value="0.25" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K2" value="8.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k3" value="0.025" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K3" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="V4" value="0.75" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K4" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="k5" value="0.025" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K5" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="V6" value="0.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K6" value="15.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="J_MKKK_act" name="MAPKKK Activation with Feedback" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKKK_P" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="MAPK_PP"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(V1 * MKKK) / ((1 + MAPK_PP / Ki) * (K1 + MKKK))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MKKK_deact" name="MAPKKK Deactivation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKKK_P" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(V2 * MKKK_P) / (K2 + MKKK_P)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MKK_act" name="MAPKK Phosphorylation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKK_PP" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="MKKK_P"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(k3 * MKKK_P * MKK) / (K3 + MKK)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MKK_deact" name="MAPKK Dephosphorylation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MKK_PP" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MKK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(V4 * MKK_PP) / (K4 + MKK_PP)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MAPK_act" name="MAPK Phosphorylation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MAPK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MAPK_PP" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="MKK_PP"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(k5 * MKK_PP * MAPK) / (K5 + MAPK)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="J_MAPK_deact" name="MAPK Dephosphorylation" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="MAPK_PP" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="MAPK" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <kineticLaw><formula>(V6 * MAPK_PP) / (K6 + MAPK_PP)</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>

<sedML xmlns="http://sed-ml.org/sed-ml/level1/version4" level="1" version="4">

      <listOfVariables>

      <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">

      </math>
